On team orders Bouriat, 2m30s ahead, waits short of the line for Chiron and lets him win.
This shameless exhibition of an absurd arrangement did not go down well with the crowd.
Chiron wins from Bouriat; Divo third, ahead of Duray, Zehender, Montier Sr. and Ledure.

The race was held over 40 laps of a 14.914 km circuit for a total race distance of 596.560 km and was won by Louis Chiron driving a Bugatti; however moral victor was Guy Bouriat, who led into the 40th lap, but was forced to wait on the start/finish line by Jean Bugatti to allow Chiron to win.
Henri Stoffel had been running behind Bouriat until running out of fuel on the final lap.
